To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) htmldate can be applied to large corpora, (2) it is able to find the publication date of a web page with high accuracy, (3) its performance is robust to different document types and (4) it is able of finding both the original and updated publication dates.

the htmldate software can: • identify the publication date of a web page • identify the date of a page update • find the publication date of an archived version of a page • find the publication dates of all the versions of a web page that are available online • find all the dates that are mentioned in a web page (in a structured way) • find the publication or update date of a web document that is not a web page • find the dates that are contained in an HTML element

the htmldate software can find both the publication and the updated publication date of web pages, that the software is rule based and relies on HTML markup as well as heuristics, and that it currently focuses on texts in English and German.

the development and evaluation of a rule based algorithm to extract publication and modification dates of HTML documents, with a focus on the English and German languages.
the extraction of the date of publication and the last update of web pages.
the extraction of web content, with a particular focus on the identification and removal of non relevant material.
